english.name: Bank of Greece Insurance Intermediary Certification
english.fullName: Bank of Greece professional knowledge certification for insurance agents, brokers and insurance-based investment products, in Greek

notes: 3 tests x 60 = 180 (the real exam draws at least 60 questions, Act 153/2/2019 art. 6); the last 2/3/3/3/2/3/3/1 items of each pool (20) are training-only. passPct 90 = 54 of 60, the real line (art. 7(5): 90% correct). Training: six topic sets 25401-25406 (Αρχές και σύμβαση 50, Διανομή και συμπεριφορά 54, Ασφαλίσεις ζημιών 26, Ζωή και υγεία 24, IBIP 24, Ξέπλυμα χρήματος και δεδομένα 22), so 6 sets + 3 tests = 9 dashboard steps. Per-test weights are Tigertest's: the Bank of Greece publishes no topic counts.
